This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|gray]] skin with faint blue stripes, sunken [[eye]]s that featured blue irises with red rings around them, and unique facial apparatuses that covered both [[ear]]s, full of what appeared to be a thick liquid that ranged from green to red in coloration.

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places the [[Battle of Exegol]] one year after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[34 ABY]], therefore putting the battle in [[35 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] as part of [[Citizens' Fleet|the fleet]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' gathered from the [[Core Worlds]], traveling to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to join their victory celebrations afterwards.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Facial-Apparatus-Species-Costume-Concepts.png|thumb|right|200px|Costume concept art by Calum Alexander Watt]]
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> They were initially design by concept artist and sculptor [[Louis Wiltshire]], with their design expanded upon by outfit artist [[Calum Alexander Watt]].<ref name="CAW">{{Instagram|username=calumalexanderwatt|url=p/B_uyi6aHkPJ|name=[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-05-03|quote=From The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker. Costume concept art for Resistance Base crowd. Creature designed and sculpted by Louis Wiltshire 2018.
